summary: Wired The Tale of the Disgraced (oracle-l5r-10553, strategy-wave-28) on the multi-target primitive: two up-front slots (your unbowed Personality via a new own-unbowed-personality category, an enemy card) and the existing delayed straighten, per Mendon's ruling that the first bow is an effect, so the two bows and the straighten are independent effects (a negated first bow stops neither the second bow nor the straighten). Fallen and Magistrate are keywords; the condition is read when the action resolves.
